maya: lunchtime thought experiment 
if the office toaster were an LLM, which model would it be? :toast: 
liam: ancient-but-stable model. always verbose on the knob descriptions, burns occasionally. :sweat_smile: 
dev on: single-parameter model: just 'CRISPNESS'. any more and it panics. 
ash: I call it 'BagelBabbler' 
kelly: gpt-4o-toaster: apologizes, drafts a heartfelt apology note to the toast, suggests a playlist to soothe it. :crying_face: 
ryan: ops-bot: "Toaster v1.3 deployed: latency 3s, throughput 2 slices/min, crumb-leak detected." :robot_face: 
maya: poll reactions? :thumbsup: old-school reliable, :fire: drama-toaster, :clap: empathetic-llm-toaster 
liam: :thumbsup: 
dev on: :fire: 
kelly: :clap: 
maya: prompt engineering is wild here: `Please produce a golden-brown slice, not a small pyre.` still gets charcoal sometimes. 
liam: we need unit tests: `assert(slice.color == "golden")` 
ryan: can someone build a toaster dashboard? metrics: toast latency, crumb-cache hit rate, #burns today. I'd stare at that. 
dev on: naming idea: 'Redwood Crisp' 
maya: love it. OK team potluck theme decided. I'll post a tiny poll in #random for real. :tada: 
ops-bot: kitchen alert: router reboot at 3pm. toaster may be unavailable ~2 minutes. :bell:
